parts.text: Which claim treats the list as a mathematical pattern?

options.text: Each term is 3 more than the one before, because we keep adding 3.
The list looks tidy, so it is a pattern with no rule needed.
Saying the rule is what creates the multiples of 3.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.

part_answers.answer: A mathematical pattern needs a clear regularity and a reason the regularity continues; here each term grows by adding 3.

teacher.key_rationale: Adding 3 each time is both the regularity and the reason it continues. Neat looks alone omit the rule. Claiming the explanation creates the multiples reverses the relation.
